name: Certified AI Tax Professional
description: Using AI across US individual, corporate, indirect and payroll tax work, safely and within IRS and state rules.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Tax Professional

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Individual Tax Preparers: Form 1040, Circular 230 and IRS Data Security (PRO-130); AI for Corporate Income Tax and the ASC 740 Provision (PRO-235); AI for Sales and Use Tax Compliance after Wayfair (PRO-240); AI for Payroll and Employment Tax (PRO-245). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
